title: Question Tags
description: Short questions at the end of statements
examples: You're coming to the party, aren't you?
He won't be late, will he?
She doesn't like coffee, does she?
I need to finish this report tonight, don't I?
We should start cooking now, shouldn't we?
She's been to Paris before, hasn't she?
He's never been to Asia, has he?
You aren't afraid of heights, are you?
They won't mind if we borrow their car, will they?
You didn't forget your keys, did you?
It's a beautiful day today, isn't it?
They didn't enjoy the movie, did they?
